# Rasterize Match WGS84 Polygon

A WGS84 polygon chosen to overlap the bundled UTM boundary raster once reprojected to EPSG:32633. Used to verify that robust rasterization can reproject vector input correctly.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Case ID | `rasterize_match_wgs84_polygon` |
| Category | vector |
| Format | GeoJSON |
| Geometry type | Polygon |
| CRS | `EPSG:4326` |
| Test tier | unit |
| Size class | tiny |
| Storage class | bundled |
| Redistributable | yes |
| Loader | `geopandas` |
| Status | validated |

```python
import pytest

def test_rasterize_match_wgs84_polygon(geocase_case) -> None:
    data = geocase_case.load()
    assert data is not None
```

## What this case checks

Confirm that vector geometries in WGS84 can be reprojected to the raster grid CRS and successfully rasterized.

## Risk types covered

- [`rasterization_alignment`](../../risk/rasterization-alignment.md)
- [`reprojection_error`](../../risk/reprojection-error.md)
